instructions: Analyze this chapter segment faithfully. Capture its thesis, role, ideas, representative evidence, objections, and qualifications. Cite source unit IDs.

units.text: [1] LinkedIn Help, "Apply for jobs on LinkedIn" and "Apply to jobs directly on LinkedIn," describing Easy Apply and external application flows. Accessed September 2026. https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a512388 and https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a512348

[2] LinkedIn Business, "How to Use LinkedIn Recruiter to Search for Candidates" and LinkedIn Recruiter product materials, describing advanced candidate search filters and sourcing. Accessed September 2026. https://business.linkedin.com/hire/resources/talent-acquisition/how-to-use-linkedin-recruiter

[3] LinkedIn, Sales Navigator product and help materials, describing lead and account search, filters, and engagement. Accessed September 2026. https://business.linkedin.com/sell/sales-navigator and https://www.linkedin.com/help/sales-navigator/answer/a735730

[4] LinkedIn Help, "Easy Apply limits," explaining limits intended to promote intentional applications and curb automation and bots. Accessed September 2026. https://www.linkedin.com/help/linkedin/answer/a8068422

[5] Microsoft, Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, describing LinkedIn revenue drivers including Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Marketing Solutions. Filed July 29, 2026. https://microsoft.gcs-web.com/static-files/8a9beeed-0e9e-48e6-b4fb-593d558e2693

[6] Upwork, "Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results," reporting full-year revenue of $787.8 million, 785,000 active clients, and GSV per active client. February 9, 2026. https://investors.upwork.com/news-releases/news-release-details/upwork-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-financial

[7] Angi Inc., Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, describing service requests, leads, matching, booking, and home-service providers. Filed February 2026. https://ir.angi.com/static-files/d3031b4a-745e-42cc-8b21-d749dd0ed2f2

[8] CORDIS, European Commission, "About CORDIS" and CORDIS Data Lab, describing the repository of EU-funded projects, participants, results, and collaboration networks. Accessed September 2026. https://cordis.europa.eu/about and https://cordis.europa.eu/datalab
[9] EURAXESS, European Commission, partnering, jobs, funding, hosting, and Innovation Talent Platform materials. Accessed September 2026. https://euraxess.ec.europa.eu/

[10] ORCID, "What is ORCID?" and "ORCID for Researchers," describing persistent identifiers and trusted connections between researchers, affiliations, and contributions. Accessed September 2026. https://info.orcid.org/what-is-orcid/ and https://info.orcid.org/researchers/

[11] Linux Foundation and A2A Project, materials on the Agent2Agent protocol, open agent interoperability, capability discovery, and adoption. The Linux Foundation reported more than 150 supporting organizations in April 2026. https://www.linuxfoundation.org/press/a2a-protocol-surpasses-150-organizations-lands-in-major-cloud-platforms-and-sees-enterprise-production-use-in-first-year and https://a2a-protocol.org/latest/

[12] Model Context Protocol, official specification and July 28, 2026 release notes, describing a standard protocol for connecting AI applications to tools and data, with authorization hardening and extensions. https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification and https://blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28/

[13] W3C, "Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0," W3C Recommendation, May 15, 2025, and related JOSE/COSE specification. https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-data-model-2.0/ and https://www.w3.org/TR/vc-jose-cose/

[14] European Digital Identity Wallet, Architecture and Reference Framework, describing an interoperable wallet ecosystem for receiving, storing, and presenting identity data and attestations. Accessed September 2026. https://eudi.dev/latest/architecture-and-reference-framework-main/

[15] Regulation (EU) 2016/679, General Data Protection Regulation, Article 22, automated individual decision-making including profiling. https://eur-lex.europa.eu/legal-content/EN/TXT/HTML/?uri=CELEX:02016R0679-20160504

[16] European Commission, "AI Act - Regulatory Framework" and implementation timeline, updated in 2026. The Commission states that the Act became broadly applicable on August 2, 2026, with specific later dates for high-risk systems. https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai

[17] European Commission, Digital Services Act materials on transparency, accountability, recommender systems, and user rights. Accessed September 2026. https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/digital-services-act and https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/dsa-brings-transparency

[18] Recruit Holdings, corporate and investor materials describing Indeed and Glassdoor as part of a two-sided talent marketplace operating internationally. Accessed September 2026. https://recruit-holdings.com/en/
